description:
Durham's Inspiring Excellence Scholarships are merit awards for international students applying to taught master's programmes. Awards are considered alongside your course application, so the practical deadline is the admission round of your chosen programme, with values and eligibility listed on Durham's scholarships page.

Programme Highlights

  • Merit-based partial fee awards across Durham's faculties
  • No separate form in most cases — assessed with admission
  • Programme-level deadlines rather than one central date
  • Strengthens the UK postgraduate offer for self-funding students

Who Should Apply

International applicants holding offers for Durham taught master's programmes with strong academic records.

Funding and Costs

Partial tuition-fee awards for international taught-postgraduate applicants, values listed per programme. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the scholarship page for your programme's award and apply for admission in good time; any separate steps are listed there. Key deadline information: Considered with your course application — deadlines follow each programme's admission round.
